title.zh: 感恩节前美股期货下跌，关税报道引发关注
title.en: US equity futures fall ahead of Thanksgiving as tariff reports draw attention

summary.en: US equity futures were lower ahead of Thanksgiving as investors assessed reports of possible new US tariffs. October PCE inflation rose 3.8% year over year, third-quarter real GDP growth was revised to 4.3% annualized, and initial jobless claims fell to 189,000.
summary.zh: 感恩节前美股期货走低，市场关注美国可能加征关税的报道。10月PCE物价指数同比上涨3.8%，三季度实际GDP增速上修至年化4.3%，初请失业金人数降至18.9万。

title.zh: 英伟达带动周一大涨后，纳指100期货盘前领跌
title.en: Nasdaq-100 futures lead declines after Monday's Nvidia rally

summary.en: At 08:54 ET, Nasdaq-100 futures fell 2.05%, S&P 500 futures 1.23% and Dow futures 0.60% from their respective Monday 16:00 ET readings. Monday's cash session had ended with the S&P 500 up 4.60% and the Nasdaq Composite up 6.36%. The 10-year yield and dollar were lower this morning. The Philadelphia Fed's regional nonmanufacturing index improved but stayed negative, and Analog Devices reported record fiscal fourth-quarter revenue. Tuesday's consumer confidence data and Wednesday's PCE inflation report are the next major tests.
summary.zh: 美东时间08:54，纳指100、标普500及道指期货较各自周一16:00的参考值分别下跌2.05%、1.23%和0.60%。周一现货收盘时，标普500上涨4.60%，纳斯达克综合指数上涨6.36%。今早10年期美债收益率和美元走低。费城联储非制造业调查的地区活动指数回升但仍为负值，亚德诺公布创纪录的财年第四季度营收。接下来关注周二消费者信心和周三PCE通胀数据。

title.zh: 周五美股大跌，假日消费成为本周焦点
title.en: Friday's selloff puts holiday spending in focus

summary.en: U.S. index futures rose before Monday's open following a sharp selloff in Friday's cash session. The Chicago Fed's October activity index fell to -0.06 from September's revised +0.05, pointing to growth slightly below trend. Investors will watch Wednesday's October PCE and second estimate of third-quarter GDP, along with holiday-season consumer spending.
summary.zh: 周五美股现货大跌后，周一主要股指期货在开盘前回升。芝加哥联储10月全国活动指数由9月修正后的+0.05降至-0.06，显示经济增速略低于趋势。市场关注周三公布的10月PCE和三季度GDP第二次估算，以及假日购物季的实际消费表现。

title.en: S&P 500 extends losing streak to six sessions as holiday spending comes into focus

summary.en: As of 09:00 EST, equity futures were lower versus their own Thursday 16:00 EST readings, with S&P 500 futures down 0.85%, Nasdaq-100 futures down 1.61% and Dow futures down 0.28%. That follows a sixth straight cash-session loss for the S&P 500, which closed down 1.98% Thursday and dropped below its 200-day average this week. The 10-year Treasury yield and the U.S. Dollar Index eased, Ross Stores raised full-year EPS guidance, and the November Michigan consumer sentiment reading was scheduled for 10:00 EST.
summary.zh: 截至美东时间09:00，三大股指期货较各自周四16:00的报价均下跌，标普500期货跌0.85%，纳指100期货跌1.61%，道指期货跌0.28%。标普500现货指数周四收跌1.98%，连续第六个交易日下跌，本周跌破200日均线。10年期美债收益率和美元指数走低，Ross Stores上调全年每股收益指引，密歇根大学11月消费者信心终值定于美东时间10:00发布。

title.zh: 周三回顾：股指收盘分化，零售股走强
title.en: Wednesday recap: indexes finish mixed while retailers advance

summary.en: Information through 09:00 EST: S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 futures are up 0.97% and 1.71% versus the prior cash-close reference after Wednesday's mixed session. Official initial jobless claims rose to 203,000 from a revised 202,000. Wednesday's minutes discussion keeps rate risk in focus; the 10-year yield is 5.085%. Palo Alto Networks' fiscal Q1 report came after its 9.9% regular-session gain, and the dollar is slightly lower while oil rebounds.
summary.zh: 信息截至纽约时间09:00 EST：周三涨跌互现后，标普500和纳指100期货较上一交易日美股常规收盘时的参考值涨0.97%、1.71%。官方初请失业金人数增至203,000人，前周修正为202,000人。周三会议纪要讨论使利率风险仍受关注，10年期收益率为5.085%。PANW第一财季报告在其常规交易涨9.9%之后公布；美元微跌，原油反弹。

title.zh: 英伟达公布第三财季业绩，上调2028财年营收增长展望
title.en: Nvidia reports fiscal Q3 results and raises fiscal 2028 revenue-growth outlook

summary.en: Information through 09:00 EST: Nasdaq-100 and S&P 500 futures are up 0.81% and 0.36% versus the prior cash-close reference following Nvidia's results and higher fiscal 2028 revenue-growth outlook. October housing starts rose 9.9% monthly while permits fell 7.4%. The dollar is firmer, oil and gold futures are lower, and the Fed's October minutes remain scheduled for 14:00 EST. Anthropic's expected pricing is still unconfirmed.
summary.zh: 信息截至纽约时间09:00 EST：英伟达公布财报并上调2028财年营收增长展望后，纳指100和标普500期货较上一交易日美股常规收盘时的参考值涨0.81%、0.36%。已公布的10月新屋开工环比增9.9%，许可降7.4%。美元走强，原油和黄金期货走低；美联储10月会议纪要仍待14:00 EST公布，Anthropic预期发行定价尚未确认。

summary.en: Information through 09:00 EST: US futures are mixed after Monday's selloff, with Nasdaq-100 futures up 0.23% and S&P 500 futures down 0.20% versus the previous cash-close reference. This week brings Nvidia's Tuesday results, Anthropic's planned IPO and a Monday speech by Fed Chair Kevin Warsh.

summary.en: Information through 09:00 EST: US futures attempt a modest recovery after Thursday's decline, with S&P 500 futures up 0.42% and Nasdaq-100 futures up 0.20% versus the previous cash close. October PPI rose 0.3% month over month and 6.5% year over year; the measure excluding food, energy and trade services rose 0.5%. Treasury yields remain elevated as next week's AI catalysts approach.

title.zh: CoreWeave业绩及合同关联融资计划支持周三半导体板块上涨
title.en: CoreWeave results and contract-linked financing support Wednesday's semiconductor rally

summary.en: Information through 09:00 EST: Wednesday's AI-led advance faces a weaker opening setup, with S&P 500 futures down 0.68% and Nasdaq-100 futures down 1.30% versus the previous US cash close. title.zh: 高盛在10月通胀数据公布后，将3月加息25个基点纳入美联储展望
title.en: Goldman adds a March 25bp Fed hike to its outlook after October inflation data

summary.en: US equities face a tech-led recovery attempt after Tuesday's losses. CoreWeave reported revenue growth of 168% and a path to profitability in H1 2028, while Goldman Sachs added a March 25bp Fed hike to its outlook after the October inflation report. Nasdaq-100 futures are up 1.94% and S&P 500 futures 0.98% versus the previous US cash close, but a 0.52% stronger dollar highlights the tension between AI optimism and tighter policy expectations. US stock markets are open on Veterans Day; the 4.983% Treasury yield is a previous bond-session reference during the fixed-income holiday.
summary.zh: 美股在周二下跌后迎来科技股带动的修复尝试。CoreWeave报告营收增长168%，并给出2028年上半年实现盈利的展望；高盛则在10月通胀数据公布后，将3月加息25个基点纳入美联储利率展望。纳斯达克100期货较上一交易日美股常规收盘时的参考值上涨1.94%，标普500期货上涨0.98%，但美元指数走强0.52%，显示AI乐观预期与政策收紧预期之间仍有拉锯。退伍军人节当天美股照常交易；债市假日期间，4.983%的美债收益率仅作为前一债市交易日参考。

title.zh: 美国 CPI 十月上涨 0.4%，增强十二月加息概率
title.en: US CPI rises 0.4% in October, strengthening December rate hike odds

summary.en: October inflation data exceeded expectations, reinforcing Federal Reserve rate hike expectations for December. S&P 500 futures declined sharply while Dow E-minis edged higher in premarket trading. Treasury yields and the dollar index rose alongside the hotter-than-expected consumer price report.
summary.zh: 十月通胀数据超出预期，强化了美联储十二月加息的预期。标普 500 期货大幅下跌，而道指 E-mini 期货在盘前交易中小幅上涨。美债收益率和美元指数随通胀报告超预期而上升。

title.zh: 纳指因中期选举后AI板块抛售跌入修正区间；10月CPI周二公布，检验约80%的12月加息概率
title.en: Nasdaq in correction after post-midterm AI selloff; October CPI due Tuesday tests ~80% December rate-hike odds

summary.en: US equities face a week of key technology earnings, including CoreWeave, and Tuesday's October CPI release on a fragile footing after the Nasdaq slid into correction territory amid post-midterm AI data-center regulatory concerns. Premarket futures point to a modest broad-based rebound following Friday's tech-led recovery, but the roughly 80% market-implied probability of a December Fed rate hike and firm core-services inflation expectations remain headwinds. The key test is whether CoreWeave's project-financing commentary and Tuesday's CPI print can stabilize the AI trade or trigger renewed selling.
summary.zh: 纳指在中期选举后的AI数据中心监管忧虑中跌入回调区间，美股以脆弱态势迎来包括CoreWeave在内的本周科技公司财报，以及周二公布的10月CPI。周五科技股领涨反弹后，盘前股指期货显示市场可能普遍小幅反弹，但市场隐含的12月美联储加息概率约80%，叠加核心服务通胀偏强预期，仍构成阻力。关键考验在于CoreWeave的项目融资评论和周二CPI数据能否稳定AI交易，还是引发新一轮抛售。

title.zh: 亚洲股市因数据中心政策担忧大幅下跌；日经225跌6%，KOSPI跌6%，MSCI亚太跌3.9%
title.en: Asian markets fall sharply on data-center policy concerns; Nikkei -6%, KOSPI -6%, MSCI APAC -3.9%

summary.en: Asian equity markets fell sharply on Friday as traders priced in potential data-center spending constraints from new state-level political leadership, with the Nikkei 225 down 6% and South Korea's KOSPI down 6%. The BLS reported October nonfarm payrolls rose 165,000—well above the 48,000 twelve-month average—with the unemployment rate at 4.1% and average hourly earnings up 0.4% month over month to $38.00. US equity futures point modestly higher this morning (NQ +1.53%, ES +0.18%) after Thursday's broad selloff, while the 10-year Treasury yield ticked up 3.1 basis points to 4.868%.
summary.zh: 周五亚洲股市大幅下跌，交易员担忧新任州级政治领导层可能限制数据中心支出，日经225指数下跌6%，韩国KOSPI指数下跌6%。美国劳工统计局报告10月非农就业新增16.5万，远高于12个月均值4.8万，失业率变化不大，为4.1%，平均时薪环比上涨0.4%至$38.00。周四美股大幅下跌后，今晨美股期货小幅走高（NQ +1.53%，ES +0.18%），10年期美债收益率上行3.1个基点至4.868%。

title.zh: Disc Medicine：bitopertin治疗EPP的III期APOLLO试验达到全部主要和次要终点；10月$486M增发后Q3末现金约$683M
title.en: Disc Medicine: Phase 3 APOLLO trial of bitopertin in EPP meets all primary and secondary endpoints; Q3 cash ~$683M after $486M October offering

summary.en: Disc Medicine reported that its Phase 3 APOLLO trial of bitopertin in erythropoietic protoporphyria met all primary and secondary endpoints, with a 41.4% reduction in whole-blood metal-free PPIX versus placebo, and ended Q3 with approximately $683M in cash after a $486M October offering. Dogwood Therapeutics completed its Halneuron Phase 2b CINP trial (239 patients) with top-line results expected in November and closed a $5M private placement extending its runway to Q1 2027. title.en: IDEXX Q3 revenue $1,214M (+10%) and EPS $4.01; raises 2026 revenue guidance to $4,741M–$4,767M

summary.en: Information cutoff: 09:00 EST. IDEXX reported Q3 revenue of $1,214M (+10% reported and organic), raising 2026 revenue guidance to $4,741M–$4,767M and EPS guidance to $14.96–$15.16. Pathfinder reported Q3 diluted EPS of $0.32, versus $0.42 in Q2 and $0.10 a year earlier.
summary.zh: 信息截至09:00 EST。IDEXX 第三季度营收 12.14 亿美元，按披露口径和有机口径均增长 10%；2026 年营收指引上调至 47.41 亿至 47.67 亿美元，每股收益指引上调至 14.96 至 15.16 美元。Pathfinder第三季度稀释EPS为$0.32，上季为$0.42、去年同期为$0.10。

title.en: Amazon Falls 7%, Intel Plunges 25% After Earnings Disappointment

summary.en: US stocks face pressure ahead of opening as Amazon and Intel miss earnings expectations, dragging Nasdaq futures down 2%. title.en: US Stock Index Futures Drop After Alphabet Earnings Shake AI Trade

summary.en: US equity futures pared losses as Alphabet's earnings report stirs AI sector jitters. Fed held rates steady at 3.75%-4.00%, but strong GDP and rising inflation data keep yields near 5%. DXY strengthened while oil prices surged on geopolitical tensions. Mixed signals ahead for the open with growth names under pressure.
summary.zh: Alphabet 财报引发市场对 AI 板块的担忧，美股期货跌幅收窄。美联储维持利率在 3.75% 至 4.00% 不变，但强劲的 GDP 数据和通胀升温使美债收益率维持在 5% 附近。美元指数走强，地缘局势紧张推升油价。开盘前信号不一，成长股承压。

title.zh: 美联储将维持利率，投资者在通胀担忧中等待鹰派转向
title.en: Fed to hold rates as investors await hawkish pivot amid inflation concerns

summary.en: Markets face a pivotal day ahead of the Federal Reserve's rate decision with expectations for a hawkish hold. Tech earnings from Alphabet and Microsoft will provide key AI debt tests, while European bank earnings show strength. SK Hynix's strong results may lift semiconductors. Inflation concerns persist with AI-driven demand pushing prices higher.
summary.zh: 市场迎来美联储利率决议前的关键交易日。投资者预期美联储将维持利率不变，并释放偏鹰信号。Alphabet 和微软的财报将帮助市场评估 AI 投资相关的债务压力，欧洲银行表现强劲。SK Hynix 的强劲业绩或提振半导体板块。通胀担忧持续存在，AI 驱动的需求推高物价。

title.zh: SpaceX 财报超预期，盘前股价大涨 9%
title.en: SpaceX earnings beat expectations, stock surges 9% in premarket

summary.en: SpaceX's stellar earnings report (+9%) and Super Micro Computer surge (+12.7%) drive AI sector rally, with Nasdaq futures climbing ahead of opening bell. Chipmakers NVIDIA, AMD, and Micron jump 3% on upbeat AI sentiment despite Meta's $25B penalty headline.
summary.zh: SpaceX 强劲财报（+9%）和超微电脑大涨（+12.7%）带动 AI 板块反弹，盘前纳斯达克期货上涨。芯片股 NVIDIA、AMD 和 Micron 受积极 AI 情绪推动涨 3%，尽管 Meta 面临 250 亿美元罚款消息影响。

title.zh: CoreWeave 信用压力加剧，AI 板块重新定价持续
title.en: CoreWeave Credit Stress Intensifies, AI Sector Repricing Continues

summary.en: US markets show mixed sentiment as investors digest hot inflation data from earlier in the week. AI sector faces pressure from CoreWeave credit stress concerns while traditional sectors like energy and precious metals benefit from rate-sensitive positioning. Futures indicate cautious optimism with S&P 500 ETFs rising, Nasdaq edging higher on Tesla gains, but broader tech weighing on sentiment.
summary.zh: 美股市场呈现混合情绪，投资者正在消化本周早些时候公布的通胀数据。AI 行业因 CoreWeave 信用压力而承压，而能源和贵金属等传统板块受益于利率敏感型配置。期货显示谨慎乐观：SPY 上涨，纳指因特斯拉股价上涨微涨，但科技板块整体拖累情绪。

title.zh: 上午 8:30 ET 的 CPI 通胀报告仍是今天的主要焦点
title.en: CPI Inflation Report at 8:30 AM ET Remains Day's Primary Focus

summary.en: Premarket sentiment cautious as investors await key CPI inflation data at 8:30 AM ET. Oil prices elevated near $106 from geopolitical supply concerns, while tech sector shows mixed signals ahead of earnings season. Market positioning defensive with growth stocks waiting for inflation clarity before directional moves.
summary.zh: 盘前情绪谨慎，投资者等待上午 8:30 ET 的关键 CPI 通胀数据。受地缘政治供应担忧影响，油价维持在近 106 美元的高位，而科技板块在财报季前走势分化。市场配置偏向防御，成长股投资者等待通胀形势进一步明朗。

title.zh: 美股期货在 CPI 数据前上涨；BlackRock 因积极催化剂而跳涨
title.en: US Stock Futures Rise Ahead of CPI Data; BlackRock Jumps on Positive Catalyst

summary.en: Stock futures rose in premarket as investors awaited the key CPI inflation report at 8:30 AM ET. Oil prices climbed near $106 following Aramco strike supply concerns, while BlackRock shares jumped on positive catalysts. Mixed sentiment with growth stocks holding steady ahead of rate-sensitive positioning.

title.zh: 美股期货因地缘政治不确定性和油价波动而表现分化
title.en: US Stock Futures Mixed on Geopolitical Uncertainty and Oil Price Fluctuations

summary.en: U.S. stock futures were mixed ahead of Monday's open as investors assessed geopolitical developments, with oil prices fluctuating amid ceasefire claims and Iran tensions. The market is positioning for an earnings-heavy week led by large banks, while AI chip stocks remain under pressure from OpenAI revenue concerns but show signs of recovery.
summary.zh: 美股期货在周一开盘前表现分化，投资者正在评估地缘政治发展，油价在停火声明与伊朗紧张局势间波动。市场正布局以大型银行为主的业绩周，而受 OpenAI 收入担忧打压的 AI 芯片股显示复苏迹象。

title.en: Wall Street futures slip as tech stocks take a breather amid elevated Treasury yields

summary.en: Wall Street futures slip amid stubbornly high Treasury yields, with investors weighing elevated rates against ongoing AI sector momentum. Key market data shows Dow Jones futures -0.14%, Nasdaq 100 futures -0.24% while oil prices dip to ~$90-105 on G7 reserve releases. DXY strengthens as Fed rate-cut bets unwind.
summary.zh: 美股期货在国债收益率保持坚挺的背景下小幅走弱，投资者在高利率与持续 AI 板块动量之间权衡。关键市场数据显示道琼斯期货下跌 0.14%，纳斯达克 100 期货下跌 0.24%，油价因 G7 释放战略储备而跌至约 90-105 美元区间。美元指数在美联储降息预期退潮后走强。

title.zh: 亚洲市场因贸易紧张担忧而下跌
title.en: Asian Markets Decline on Trade Tension Concerns

summary.en: Asian markets close mixed with Japan and Korea indexes slightly lower amid ongoing trade tension concerns. Pre-market futures indicate modest downside pressure on U.S. equities as investors digest geopolitical developments in the Middle East and assess their impact on oil prices, inflation expectations, and Fed policy timing. Key focus remains on whether supply chain disruptions will anchor inflation above the Fed's 2% target.
summary.zh: 亚洲市场收市分化，日本和韩国指数小幅下跌，贸易紧张局势持续引发担忧。美股盘前期货暗示适度下行压力，投资者正在消化中东地缘政治发展及其对油价、通胀预期和美联储政策时机的影响。重点关注供应链中断是否会迫使通胀锚定在美联储 2% 目标之上。

summary.zh: 美股开盘前，亚洲股市表现分化，市场聚焦科技股财报与美联储官员言论。油价在关键支撑位附近企稳，尽管地缘政治紧张持续。美元指数窄幅震荡等待 CPI 数据公布；美债收益率稳定在 4.1% 左右。

title.zh: 美国股票期货持平，地缘政治谈话抵消 AI 上涨
title.en: U.S. Stock Futures Flat as Geopolitical Talks Offset AI Rally

summary.en: U.S. index futures flat to slightly down as geopolitical de-escalation hopes (Iran talks, Mideast summit) offset AI sector optimism. Oil retreats below $95 with Gulf supply increase and pipeline repair reducing crisis premium. Pre-market focus on Trump-Xi summit preparation alongside Fed rate decision anticipation for Thursday.
summary.zh: 美国指数期货基本持平至轻微下跌，地缘政治缓和希望（伊朗谈话、中东峰会）抵消 AI 板块乐观情绪。油价回落至 95 美元以下，海湾供应增加和管道维修减少了危机溢价。盘前焦点为特朗普与习近平峰会准备，以及周四美联储利率决策预期。

title.zh: 成长股与价值股之间的板块轮动持续
title.en: Sector Rotation Continues Between Growth and Value Stocks

summary.en: US pre-market shows mixed sentiment with sector rotation continuing between growth and value stocks. Treasury yields remain elevated while oil prices stabilize, creating uncertainty for rate-sensitive sectors. title.en: Asian Equity Indices Decline as US Investors Brace for FOMC Decision Amid Geopolitical Oil Shock

summary.en: Pre-market attention on Fed Chair Warsh's ongoing rate policy communication amid geopolitical oil supply disruption from Middle East. Asian markets showed mixed signals overnight with Japan/Korea declining while energy-related sectors outperformed. Investors await tomorrow's FOMC decision for clarity on inflation trajectory and timing of the rate hike.
summary.zh: 盘前焦点关注美联储主席 Warsh 持续的利率政策沟通，同时中东地缘政治油价供应中断引发关注。亚洲市场隔夜表现分化，日/韩指数下跌而能源相关板块超额表现。投资者等待明天的 FOMC 决策以获取通胀轨迹和加息时机的明朗化。

summary.en: U.S. stocks fell sharply amid escalating Middle East tensions, with oil prices surging toward $100/barrel following attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure and Iranian tanker by Houthi rebels. The Dow Jones slid ~550 points while inflation concerns pushed Treasury yields higher.
summary.zh: 美国股市大幅下跌，中东紧张局势升级。油价受也门胡塞武装袭击沙特能源设施及伊朗油轮事件影响飙升至 100 美元/桶附近。道琼斯指数下跌约 550 点，通胀担忧推动美债收益率上升。

title.zh: Jackson Hole 央行峰会前美联储讲话维持偏鹰基调
title.en: Jackson Hole Fed speakers maintain rate-hawkish tone ahead of central bank summit

summary.en: Fed speakers at Jackson Hole remain hawkish, with Powell's recent comments keeping rate-cut expectations in check through Q3. Treasury yields steadied after last week's July PCE print, while oil continues to face pressure from Middle East de-escalation hopes despite supply constraints. Tech leads broadly, but the rally is event-driven and sensitive to Fed commentary rather than a full macro breakout.
summary.zh: Jackson Hole 美联储讲话保持偏鹰，鲍威尔的近期表态使降息预期在 Q3 内受限。美债收益率在上周 7 月 PCE 数据后企稳，而油价仍受中东降温预期压制。科技股领涨，但行情是事件驱动的，对美联储讲话高度敏感，而非全面的宏观突破。

title.zh: 主要云服务商扩大 GPU 基础设施，推动 AI 芯片需求激增
title.en: AI Chip Demand Surges as Major Cloud Providers Expand GPU Infrastructure

summary.en: Pre-market focus remains on earnings season continuation with key semiconductor and AI chip designers reporting, while geopolitical developments in the Middle East continue to influence oil prices and inflation expectations. Market breadth appears cautious ahead of Thursday's open.
summary.zh: 财报季尚未结束，盘前投资者关注半导体与 AI 芯片设计公司的业绩。中东局势仍影响油价和通胀预期。周四开盘前，个股表现和市场情绪仍偏谨慎。

title.en: Wall Street futures little changed as Iran tensions lift oil prices to $90+ territory

summary.en: U.S. futures flat after three straight losing sessions, with geopolitical tensions from Iran offsetting AI sector optimism. Oil surges past $90 as yields climb, creating headwinds for rate-sensitive growth stocks.

title.zh: 油价飙升突破$90，美伊紧张局势升级；期指下跌
title.en: Oil Surges Above $90 as US-Iran Tensions Flare Up; Futures Drop

summary.en: US-Iran tensions spike oil above $90 and push yields higher, weighing on tech-heavy futures across the board. Weak opening sentiment as investors price-in inflation risks from energy markets before September begins.

title.zh: 美债收益率维持稳定，市场等待 9 月数据发布
title.en: Treasury Yields Hold Steady as Markets Await September Data

summary.en: US markets closed Friday with mixed sentiment ahead of September's economic data calendar. Pre-market attention focuses on Fed speaker expectations, Treasury yield stability, and positioning around upcoming earnings season. Geopolitical tensions continue to influence oil prices and inflation expectations.
summary.zh: 美国股市周五收盘呈现混合情绪，9 月经济数据日历在即。盘前关注焦点在于联储讲话预期、美债收益率稳定以及围绕即将展开的财报季的配置。地缘政治紧张局势继续影响油价和通胀预期。

title.zh: AI 反弹中，芯片股继续跑赢大科技
title.en: Chipmakers are outshining Big Tech in the AI rally

summary.en: AI-led buying is still carrying the tape, with Nasdaq futures outperforming as chip momentum rolls through the supply chain. But higher Treasury yields, a firmer dollar, and weaker gold show the market is still pricing a hawkish Jackson Hole backdrop rather than a clean risk-on breakout.
summary.zh: AI 仍然是盘面的主导线，纳指期货领涨，资金正沿着芯片和数据中心供应链扩散。但美债收益率更高、美元更强、黄金走弱，说明市场交易的仍是偏鹰的 Jackson Hole 背景，而不是干净利落的 风险偏好回升 突破。

title.zh: Nvidia 亮眼财报重新点燃 AI 交易
title.en: Nvidia's blockbuster results refuel the AI trade

summary.en: Nvidia's blockbuster results reignited the AI trade and pushed Nasdaq futures sharply higher, but the tape is still carrying a sticky July PCE print and Jackson Hole risk in the background. Treasury yields are softer and oil is sliding on Middle East de-escalation hopes, so the setup is risk-on for semis and mega-cap tech but still event-driven rather than cleanly bullish.
summary.zh: Nvidia 强劲的财报与指引重新点燃了 AI 交易，并推动纳指期货明显走高，但粘性的 7 月 PCE 和 Jackson Hole 风险仍在背景中压着市场。美债收益率回落、油价因中东降温预期下跌，所以当前更像半导体和大科技领涨的事件驱动型偏多环境，而不是干净的全面 风险偏好回升。

title.zh: NVIDIA 发布 Q2 FY27 财报，指引营收接近 910 亿美元，AI 芯片需求激增
title.en: NVIDIA Reports Q2 FY27 Earnings, Guidance Near $91B Revenue as AI Chip Demand Surges

summary.en: Markets eye NVIDIA's Q2 earnings report and July PCE inflation data, with Dow futures rising while Nasdaq slips ahead of AI chip giant results. Oil prices soften on constructive Oman-Iran talks easing Hormuz Strait concerns, while Treasury yields edge higher ahead of Fed's preferred inflation gauge release. Geopolitical developments in Middle East continue to drive cross-asset transmission from energy to inflation expectations.
summary.zh: 市场聚焦 NVIDIA 第二季财报和七月 PCE 通胀数据，道指期货上涨而纳斯达克下跌以等待 AI 芯片巨头业绩。油价因阿曼伊朗对话缓和霍尔木兹海峡担忧而回落，美债收益率在美联储偏好通胀指标发布前小幅走高。中东地缘政治发展继续驱动能源向通胀预期的跨资产传导。

summary.en: US stock futures edge higher pre-market as tech stocks rebound from Monday's selloff, led by Nvidia ahead of its high-stakes Wednesday earnings report. Investors are cautiously optimistic despite pending inflation (PCE) and GDP data releases Tuesday.

title.zh: 霍尔木兹缓和预期推高股指期货，并压低原油冲击
title.en: Hormuz De-escalation Hopes Lift Futures and Ease the Oil Shock

summary.en: Premarket tone is modestly risk-on: index futures are higher on Hormuz de-escalation hopes, softer labor data, and a revived AI trade. The caution is that the 10Y yield is still near 4.66% and gold is also bid, so the open looks supported but still headline-sensitive and rate-sensitive.
summary.zh: 盘前基调偏风险偏好：市场在霍尔木兹局势缓和预期、偏弱就业数据和 AI 交易回暖的推动下高开。需要警惕的是，10Y 美债收益率仍接近 4.66%，黄金也同步走强，因此这更像是一个有支撑但仍对头条和利率高度敏感的开盘。

title.zh: 伊朗局势缓和预期压低油价，原油跌幅超 7%
title.en: Oil Sinks More Than 7% as Iran De-escalation Hopes Reprice the Tape

summary.en: Premarket tone is decisively risk-on: index futures are sharply higher after WTI collapsed more than 7%, easing the inflation and rate scare that has been hanging over equities. The main caution is that the 10Y yield is still grinding up to 4.66%, so the rally favors high-quality growth and other duration-sensitive winners only if rates stay contained.
summary.zh: 盘前情绪明显偏风险偏好：在 WTI 重挫逾 7% 后，三大指数期货齐涨，通胀和利率冲击得到缓解。需要留意的是，10Y 美债收益率仍上行至 4.66%，因此本轮反弹更偏向高质量成长和久期资产，前提是利率别继续失控。

title.zh: 美指期货上涨押注中东停火；医疗保健合并谈判引发关注
title.en: Wall Street Futures Rise on Middle East Truce Hopes; Healthcare Merger Talks Spark Interest

summary.en: US stocks poised to open higher as three major index futures rise on Monday. Oil prices fell below $84 amid hopes for de-escalation in the Middle East following US-Iran diplomatic signals, while healthcare sector gained focus after Bristol Myers Squibb and AstraZeneca merger talks sparked a potential ~$400B deal that could reshape the global pharmaceutical landscape.
summary.zh: 美股周一开盘料上涨，三大指数期货齐扬。受美伊外交缓和信号推动，油价跌破 84 美元；医疗保健板块因百时美施贵宝与阿斯利康合并谈判而受到关注，双方可能达成价值约 4000 亿美元的交易，或重塑全球制药格局。

summary.en: Friday markets close with mixed sentiment as semiconductor stocks diverge on AI supply chain dynamics. Semiconductor names show wide dispersion - NVIDIA and AMD rally while Micron and Intel retreat, signaling selective capital rotation within the chip sector.

title.en: Trump Pauses US Strikes on Iran, Wall Street Futures Rally

summary.en: U.S. stock futures rose as a pause in U.S.-Iran hostilities eased geopolitical concerns. Technology led gains while oil fell. The Wall Street Journal reported that Nvidia was in talks to provide about $250 billion in financing guarantees for OpenAI’s Ohio data-center project.
summary.zh: 美伊交火暂停缓解地缘风险，美股期货上涨，科技股领涨，油价下跌。《华尔街日报》报道，英伟达正商谈为 OpenAI 的俄亥俄州数据中心项目提供约 2,500 亿美元融资担保。

summary.en: U.S. stocks are mixed in premarket trading as investors weigh soft inflation data against escalating Middle East tensions, with oil surging and Treasury yields hitting eight-week highs. Bank earnings boosts sentiment but geopolitical risk premium is weighing on broader equities.
summary.zh: 美股盘前交易呈现分歧，投资者在软通胀数据与中东紧张局势升级之间权衡：油价飙升、美债收益率创八周新高。银行股业绩提振情绪，但地缘政治风险溢价抑制大盘表现。

summary.zh: 中东地缘政治升级主导盘前交易，特朗普霍尔木兹海峡收费和伊朗港口封锁推动油价突破 85 美元/桶美油；通胀预期升温抬升美国国债收益率至两个月高位；大科技股受存储芯片需求担忧拖累普遍走弱。

title.en: US declares Iran ceasefire over as Trump says Middle East tensions resolved after military strikes

summary.en: US stocks showed mixed-to-flat futures as Middle East tensions evolved with Trump declaring Iran ceasefire over. Oil prices surged >5% on WTI following US military strikes and Hormuz Strait vessel attacks, driving energy sector rally but pressuring inflation-sensitive growth names via higher yields. Fed minutes remained key focus while dollar held support at 101+. Asia markets declined overnight ahead of open.
summary.zh: 特朗普宣布对伊朗的停火结束之际，美股期货窄幅波动。美国对伊朗发动打击、霍尔木兹海峡船只遇袭后，WTI 原油上涨逾 5%，推动能源股反弹。美债收益率上行使对通胀和利率敏感的成长股承压。市场仍关注美联储会议纪要，美元指数维持在 101 上方，亚洲股市隔夜走弱。

title.zh: 半导体股遭重挫，尽管 Samsung 交出创纪录业绩但估值忧虑压倒利好消息
title.en: Semiconductor stocks slump despite Samsung's record earnings as valuation concerns dominate over profit news

summary.en: US markets extended losses from Friday following overnight weakness in Asia. Semiconductor stocks sold off despite Samsung's record quarter as investors priced-in high valuations and profit-taking amid DeepSeek chip competition concerns. Oil prices surged on renewed Middle East tensions after US strikes against Iran, while Treasury yields rose and the dollar strengthened to week-high levels.
summary.zh: 亚洲股市隔夜走弱后，美股延续跌势。尽管三星电子录得创纪录的季度业绩，半导体股仍遭抛售。投资者担忧估值过高，也在关注获利了结和 DeepSeek 相关的芯片竞争。美国对伊朗发动打击后，中东局势再度紧张，油价上涨。美债收益率上行，美元升至本周高点。

title.zh: 美伊多哈和平谈判受阻；地缘政治风险溢价回归
title.en: US-Iran Doha Peace Talks Stall; Geopolitical Risk Premium Returns

summary.en: US futures soften into July as geopolitical tensions dim over US-Iran Doha peace talks, Fed rate hike fears mount with ~67% odds for September policy shift, and a strong Q2 rally draws profit-taking. Markets await ISM Manufacturing PMI (flash estimate at four-year high of 55.7) ahead today's formal release later midday.
summary.zh: 美股期货在七月伊始温和回调，美伊多哈和平谈判前景降温、美联储加息预期升温（9 月政策转向概率约 67%）以及二季度反弹获利回吐成为三大主线。市场关注今日正式发布的 ISM 制造业 PMI 初值（四年高点 55.7）。

title.zh: 道指收于 52,000 点上方，科技股继续推动风险偏好回升
title.en: Dow closes above 52,000 as tech powers another risk-on session

summary.en: U.S. futures are mixed to slightly firmer after Monday's strong close, with the Dow holding above 52,000 and mega-cap tech still doing most of the work. The overnight focus is the Iran/Hormuz risk premium: oil remains high enough to support energy, but not yet high enough to force a broad inflation shock.
summary.zh: 美股期货在周一强势收盘后呈现分化但略偏强，道指站稳 52,000 点上方，推动指数的仍然主要是大市值科技股。盘前最重要的变量是伊朗与霍尔木兹海峡带来的地缘风险溢价：油价足以支撑能源板块，但还没有高到足以引发全面通胀冲击。

title.zh: 美股期货因和平谈判希望而上涨；油价维持地缘溢价
title.en: US Stock Futures Rise on Peace Talks Hope; Oil Holds Geopolitical Premium

summary.en: U.S. equity futures edge higher as investors weigh the evolving US-Iran geopolitical standoff for signs of sustained deescalation rather than fresh escalation, with oil trading near $73 driven by Strait of Hormuz concerns but still below inflation-risk thresholds.
summary.zh: 美股期货小幅走强，投资者关注美伊局势演变是否预示可持续降级而非新一轮升级，油价徘徊在 73 美元附近受霍尔木兹海峡担忧支撑但仍未达通胀警戒线。

title.zh: 美国对伊朗发动第二轮打击，OPEC+ 收紧产量削减
title.en: US Launches Second Wave of Strikes on Iran, OPEC+ Tightens Production Cuts

summary.en: US-Iran geopolitical tensions escalate as a second wave of military strikes near the Strait of Hormuz rattles energy markets and lifts oil prices. Equity futures slip ahead of U.S. market open amid concerns about supply disruptions in key shipping lanes and inflation implications from higher crude costs.
summary.zh: 美国与伊朗地缘政治紧张局势升级，第二波针对霍尔木兹海峡附近的军事打击扰乱能源市场并推高油价。美股盘前指数下跌，担忧关键航运通道的供应中断和原油成本上升的通胀影响。

title.zh: 美国确认对伊朗实施报复性打击，盘后推升油价
title.en: U.S. confirms retaliatory strike on Iran, pulling oil prices higher after hours

summary.en: The tape is event-driven into the weekend: U.S. retaliatory action on Iran has revived a fresh oil-risk premium, while Nasdaq futures lag and gold stays bid. The broad market is still only mildly softer, so this is more of a rotation shock than a full risk-off break for now.
summary.zh: 周末前的主线是典型的事件驱动：美国对伊朗的报复性行动重新抬升了原油风险溢价，纳指期货继续跑输，而黄金保持强势。整体市场只是小幅走弱，因此当前更像是风格轮动冲击，而不是全面的风险出清。

title.en: Micron (MU) earnings surge +16% after-hours sparks tech rally ahead of PCE data

summary.en: Markets edge higher in early trading with S&P +0.6%, Nasdaq +0.7% despite lingering AI valuation concerns and chip sector weakness from Korean peers (-10%). summary.en: US futures slip on mixed geopolitical signals from US-Iran peace talks, AI sector volatility led by SpaceX sell-off (-16%), and lingering high yield pressure. Market sentiment remains bifurcated between risk-on trade driven by potential Middle East de-escalation and tech-sector concerns amid Mag-7 selloff.

title.zh: 美盘前期货受 Juneteenth 假期和 US-伊朗协议预期影响回落
title.en: US Futures Retreat as Juneteenth Holiday and US-Iran Deal Loom

summary.en: US futures retreated on Juneteenth ahead of the US-Iran nuclear agreement milestone, while economic data (ADP +122K jobs, ISM Services PMI at 54.5) reinforces Fed's higher-for-longer stance amid surging oil prices ($96 WTI, $97 Brent). Chip stocks rallied on improved geopolitical sentiment and TSMC/Nvidia strength.
summary.zh: 美盘前受 Juneteenth 假期和 US-伊朗核协议里程碑影响，美股期货回落。强劲的经济数据（ADP 私营部门新增 12.2 万个岗位、ISM 服务业 PMI54.5）与飙升的油价支撑美联储维持高利率立场。芯片股在地缘政治缓和及 TSMC/Nvidia 走强带动下上涨。

title.en: U.S.-Iran Peace Deal Weighs on Oil Prices, Eases Inflation Fears

summary.en: US stocks edge higher in premarket with futures mixed as focus shifts to Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's first policy decision on June 17, while the U.S.-Iran peace deal continues weighing on oil prices. SpaceX extends its post-IPO rally above 9%, memory chip makers surge ahead of AI data center demand, and Tesla climbs alongside lower crude.
summary.zh: 美股盘前小幅走高，三大指数期货方向不一，市场焦点转向美联储新任主席沃什将在 6 月 17 日公布的首次政策决定。美伊和平协议持续压制油价，SpaceX 股价延续上市后涨势，涨幅超过 9%，存储芯片厂商受益于 AI 数据中心需求上涨，特斯拉随原油下跌而反弹。

summary.en: U.S. futures surged on a preliminary U.S.-Iran agreement easing geopolitical oil worries ahead of the Fed's June 16-17 meeting; energy-sensitive stocks rallied while AI chip leaders posted solid gains with SpaceX IPO at $2T valuation extending premarket strength.
summary.zh: 初步美伊协议缓解了原油供应忧虑，推动美股期货在美联储 6 月 16 至 17 日会议前大涨。对能源价格敏感的股票反弹，AI 芯片龙头上涨。SpaceX 上市估值约 2 万亿美元，上市后股价延续强势。

title.zh: 美伊和平协议临近：特朗普表示"即将签署"
title.en: U.S.-Iran Peace Deal Nears: Trump Signals 'Soon' on Agreement

summary.en: U.S. futures rise as investors digest President Trump's peace deal signal with Iran and await SpaceX IPO debut; oil prices fall while gold surges on geopolitical risk-off, creating mixed sentiment ahead of open.
summary.zh: 美国期指上扬的背景下，投资者关注特朗普总统关于与伊朗签署和平协议的信号以及等待 SpaceX 的首次公开募股（IPO）表现；油价下跌而黄金在避险情绪推动下上涨，盘前呈现多空交织格局。

title.zh: 美伊冲突升级推动油价飙升和市场波动
title.en: Iran-US Escalation Drives Oil Surge and Market Volatility

summary.en: May U.S. consumer prices rose 4.2% year over year, the largest increase since April 2023. Escalating U.S.-Iran tensions pushed oil higher, and semiconductor stocks came under pressure.
summary.zh: 美国 5 月 CPI 同比上涨 4.2%，为 2023 年 4 月以来最大同比涨幅。美伊紧张局势升级推升油价，半导体股票承压。

title.en: CPI Day Reckoning: May Inflation Data Exceeds Expectations as Markets Sell Off Ahead of Fed Policy Discussion

summary.en: US stock futures decline as markets digest elevated May CPI data while Middle East tensions between US and Iran escalate, sending oil prices higher despite peace deal signals. Tech sector under pressure amid inflation concerns that reignite Fed rate repricing expectations; gold trades mixed as real yields fluctuate and geopolitical risk premium weighs on safe haven appeal.
summary.zh: 美国股指期货下跌，市场消化高企的 5 月 CPI 数据同时美伊紧张局势升级推升油价。通胀担忧使市场重新评估美联储利率路径，科技股承压。实际收益率波动和地缘风险溢价影响避险需求，黄金走势分化。

title.zh: 强劲的五月份非农就业数据推高美联储加息概率，显示劳动力市场韧性
title.en: Strong May Nonfarm Payrolls Push Fed Rate Hike Probabilities Higher Amid Job Market Resilience

summary.en: US markets reopened on a mixed note following Friday's selloff, with S&P and Nasdaq futures rallying while Dow slips as investors digest strong nonfarm payrolls (172K vs 85K expected) that boost Fed rate hike probabilities. Middle East tensions between Israel and Iran have reignited oil price concerns despite peace deal signals, creating geopolitical risk premiums in energy markets while gold trades under pressure below $4,300.
summary.zh: 美国股市在周五大幅抛售后的重开表现分化，标普和纳斯达克期货上涨而道琼斯指数下滑，投资者正在消化强劲的非农就业数据（172K 远超预期的 85K），推高美联储加息概率。中东以色列与伊朗之间的紧张局势重新引发油价担忧，尽管有和平协议信号，能源市场仍存在地缘政治风险溢价，黄金在$4,300以下承压交易。

summary.en: Monday premarket is anchored by two conflicting themes: a rebound in semiconductor stocks after Friday’s sharp AI-sector selloff, and escalating Middle East tensions lifting oil prices above $95 while spiking Treasury yields near session highs ahead of Wednesday's CPI test.
summary.zh: 周一盘前由两个相互矛盾的主题主导：半导体板块在周五经历巨额抛售后的反弹，以及中东局势紧张推高油价至$95 以上并令美债收益率接近日内高点——周三将公布的关键CPI数据成为市场焦点。

title.en: Broadcom Beats Earnings But AI Guidance Flat Triggers Semiconductor Weakness

summary.en: US stocks face premarket pressure ahead of critical May Non-Farm Payrolls release tonight. Broadcom (AVGO) disappointed AI guidance despite beating estimates, triggering semiconductor sector weakness. Middle East geopolitics continue to drive oil prices and DXY volatility.
summary.zh: 美国 5 月非农就业数据公布前，美股面临盘前压力。博通（AVGO）业绩超出市场预期，但其 AI 业务指引令人失望，拖累半导体板块。中东局势仍在影响油价和美元指数。

summary.en: Mid-June market focus: AI earnings season continues with Nvidia and big tech driving sector gains; Middle East peace talks extend uncertainty on oil prices; Treasury yields remain stable near 4.5% as inflation expectations anchor amid geopolitical transmission risks.
summary.zh: 六月中旬市场焦点：AI 相关公司的财报季仍在继续，英伟达和大型科技股带动相关板块上涨；中东和平谈判延长油价不确定性；美债收益率稳定在 4.5%附近，通胀预期在地缘政治传导风险下锚定。

title.en: US Stocks Hold Flat as Investors Await Jobs Data and AI Sector Continues Rally

summary.en: US futures remain flat after a record-setting session, with SP500 and Dow futures unchanged while Nasdaq 100 futures gain 0.1%. summary.en: US futures remain flat to slightly up amid mixed Middle East developments, with Nasdaq extending AI momentum while Dow lags. title.zh: 美国股市期货升至纪录高位，AI 乐观情绪超越中东风险
title.en: U.S. Stock Futures Rise to Records as AI Optimism Trumps Middle East Risks

summary.en: U.S. stock index futures rose to record highs on Tuesday as AI-driven optimism in semiconductor stocks offset Middle East geopolitical risks, with S&P 500 E-minis up 0.78% and Nasdaq 100 E-minis gaining 1.16% in premarket trading ahead of the Fed chair's first week.
summary.zh: 周二美股股指期货创历史新高。AI 热潮提振半导体股，抵消了中东地缘风险。盘前标普 500 E-mini 期货涨 0.78%，纳斯达克 100 E-mini 期货涨 1.16%，市场也关注美联储主席上任后的首周。

title.zh: 科技板块轮动持续，投资者寻求价值替代
title.en: Tech sector rotation continues as investors seek value alternatives

summary.en: Markets mixed with sector rotation ongoing. Tech firms monitor AI spending sustainability post-NVDA miss. Oil stabilizes near $104 as geopolitical premium narrows. Treasury yields firm above 4.6% with inflation stickiness concerns. Energy sector leads session as supply constraints outweigh peace dividend.
summary.zh: 市场分化，板块轮动持续。科技公司在 NVDA 不及预期后关注 AI 支出可持续性。油价在地缘溢价收窄后稳定在 104 美元附近。10 年期收益率稳定在 4.6% 以上，通胀顽固担忧犹存。能源板块领跑，供应约束超越和平红利。

title.zh: 特朗普推迟对伊朗军事行动
title.en: Trump postpones Iran military strike

summary.en: US markets opened mixed as Trump's postponement of Iran military strike eased geopolitical tensions, though chip stocks weighed on sentiment amid inflation concerns. Oil prices remain elevated above $110/barrel, keeping energy sector supported while Treasury yields climbed to 4.68%.
summary.zh: 美股早盘震荡，特朗普推迟对伊朗军事行动缓解地缘紧张，但芯片股拖累市场情绪，通胀担忧犹存。油价维持在 110 美元/桶以上支撑能源板块，美债收益率攀升至 4.68%。

title.zh: 降级推动 10Y 美债收益率降至约 4.35%
title.en: De-escalation Drives 10Y Treasury Yield Down to ~4.35%

summary.en: 10Y Treasury Yield declined from 4.45% Thursday toward 4.35% on de-escalation. Yield compression supports duration assets. The relationship between two-year and ten-year yields remains in focus. Fed policy uncertainty persists; Powell June meeting critical. Rate-sensitive assets rally. Watch for USD flows and inflation expectation shifts.
summary.zh: 10Y 美债收益率从周四 4.45% 下降至约 4.35% 因去升级。收益率压缩支持久期资产。市场仍关注 2 年期和 10 年期美债收益率之间的利差。Fed 政策不确定性犹存；鲍威尔 6 月会议关键。利率敏感资产 上涨。关注美元资金流向和通胀预期转变。

title.zh: Trump-Xi 峰会：贸易休战延长和战略稳定框架
title.en: Trump-Xi Summit: Trade Truce Extension and Strategic Stability Framework

summary.en: US markets advance as Trump-Xi summit delivers trade truce extension but Middle East stalemate fuels inflation concerns. S&P 500 and Nasdaq extend gains to fresh highs while 10Y Treasury yield surges to 4.53% on inflation data. Brent crude jumps to $108/barrel on Iran conflict uncertainty creating stagflation toggle risk. New Fed Chair Warsh faces complex inflation picture with CPI at 3.8% and PPI at 6%.
summary.zh: 特朗普与习近平会晤后，贸易休战得以延长，美股上涨，标普 500 和纳指再创新高。中东僵局仍在加剧通胀担忧；布伦特原油因伊朗局势未明而升至每桶 108 美元。通胀数据推动 10 年期美债收益率升至 4.53%。CPI 和 PPI 分别上涨 3.8% 和 6%，新任美联储主席沃什面临复杂的通胀形势。

summary.en: US stocks trade higher ahead of Trump-Xi summit as tech rally extends with S&P 500 and Nasdaq at fresh record highs driven by AI chip demand. Brent crude stabilizes above $104/barrel on Iran ceasefire uncertainty creating stagflation toggle risk. 10Y Treasury yield near 4.46% supports duration assets despite geopolitical premium. Market positioning favors growth names as mega-cap tech leads ahead of NVDA earnings on May 20.
summary.zh: 特朗普与习近平会晤前，美股走高。AI 芯片需求推动科技股延续涨势，标普 500 和纳指再创新高。伊朗停火前景仍不明朗，布伦特原油维持在每桶 104 美元以上，滞胀风险仍受关注。10 年期美债收益率约为 4.46%。市场配置偏向成长股，大型科技股在英伟达 5 月 20 日公布财报前领涨。

title.zh: 特朗普抵达北京举行关键会晤
title.en: Trump Lands in Beijing for High-Stakes Xi Summit

summary.en: U.S. markets approach a pivotal Trump-Xi summit in Beijing amid persistent inflation concerns, with April PPI jumping 6% annually and wholesale prices rising 0.5% month-on-month. Oil prices remain elevated above $107/barrel on Middle East tensions while Treasury yields hit new yearly highs near 4.46%, creating a complex risk-off backdrop for equities.
summary.zh: 美国市场在特朗普访华之际迎来关键节点，通胀担忧持续，4 月 PPI 年增 6%、批发物价月增 0.5%。油价因中东紧张维持在每桶 107 美元以上，美债收益率触及年内新高 4.46%，为股市营造复杂防御性背景。

summary.en: US futures dipped 0.2% as Trump rejected Iran's peace proposal, keeping geopolitical risk elevated. Strong April jobs report (115K vs 62K consensus) reinforced higher-for-longer rates. AI momentum remains intact with semiconductor giants leading, while oil fluctuates near $100/bbl and gold slips on inflation fears.
summary.zh: 美股期货下跌 0.2%，因特朗普拒绝伊朗和平提议，地缘政治风险高企。强劲的 4 月就业报告（11.5 万 vs 6.2 万共识）强化了更高更持久的利率预期。AI 势头依然强劲，半导体巨头领先，油价徘徊在每桶 100 美元附近，黄金因通胀担忧下滑。

title.zh: 市场因美中伊朗和平协议乐观情绪上涨；原油暴跌
title.en: Markets Rally on US-Iran Peace Deal Optimism; Oil Plunges

summary.en: US stocks extend gains on optimism over US-Iran peace prospects as crude oil drops, with S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures near record highs while Dow lags. Oil plunges toward $100/barrel on Strait of Hormuz reopening hopes, easing inflation fears and supporting risk-on sentiment. Treasury yields compress as de-escalation narrative strengthens; sector rotation shifts from energy to tech as stagflation concerns abate. Fed policy uncertainty persists with rate-cut expectations intact.
summary.zh: 市场对美伊和平前景转趋乐观，美股延续涨势。市场预期霍尔木兹海峡可能重开，油价跌向每桶 100 美元，缓解了通胀担忧。标普 500 和纳指期货接近纪录高位，道指表现相对落后。随着地缘紧张缓和，美债收益率回落，资金从能源股转向科技股。美联储政策前景仍不明朗，市场仍预期降息。

title.en: US Stocks Near Records as Iran Response to US Proposal Expected

summary.en: US stock futures edge higher near record highs as investors await Iran's reply to US peace proposal. Oil rebounds to ~$102/barrel on Middle East tensions, supporting energy sector. Tech remains resilient with AI momentum; 10Y Treasury yield stabilizes at 4.37%. Sector rotation continues between energy cyclicals and rate-sensitive growth names.

title.zh: 中东局势升级：美伊在霍尔木兹海峡冲突
title.en: Middle East Tensions Escalate: U.S.-Iran Clash in Strait of Hormuz

summary.en: U.S. stock futures mixed as Middle East tensions dominate. U.S.-Iran flare-up in Strait of Hormuz is driving oil prices higher and inflating inflation risks. Investors are weighing geopolitical escalation against resilient earnings, with sector rotation toward energy and away from rate-sensitive growth.
summary.zh: 美股期指走势分化，中东紧张局势主导盘前焦点。美国与伊朗在霍尔木兹海峡的冲突升级推动油价飙升，引发通胀担忧。投资者在稳健财报与地缘风险之间权衡，资金向能源板块轮动，避开对利率敏感的成长股。

summary.en: US stocks hover near record highs as markets digest GameStop's surprise $56B eBay takeover bid and assess US-Iran peace progress. Oil jumps 5% on Strait of Hormuz tensions, creating stagflation concerns even as futures show muted gains.
summary.zh: 美股在纪录高位附近徘徊，市场消化 GameStop 对 eBay 的 560 亿美元突袭收购要约，并评估美伊和平进展。因霍尔木兹海峡紧张局势油价上涨 5%，引发滞胀担忧，尽管期货涨幅有限。

title.zh: 美伊和谈受阻、霍尔木兹运输仍受限，油价升至两周高位
title.en: Oil jumps to a two-week high as U.S.-Iran peace talks stall and Hormuz shipments remain limited

summary.en: U.S. equity futures are leaning modestly higher, but the real premarket story is cross-asset tension: oil is extending its surge above $109 as U.S.-Iran talks stall and Strait of Hormuz flows stay constrained, while the 10-year Treasury yield edges up to about 4.35%. That keeps the tape investable for tech, but more fragile for the broad market because higher energy and firmer yields revive inflation-risk concerns.
summary.zh: 美股期货盘前偏强，但真正的主线在跨资产：由于美伊谈判受阻、霍尔木兹海峡运输仍受限制，油价继续冲到 109 美元上方；与此同时，10 年期美债收益率回到约 4.35%。这意味着科技股情绪还能撑住，但大盘层面更脆弱，因为更高的能源价格和收益率重新抬升了通胀风险。

title.zh: 美国拦截三艘伊朗油轮；油价飙升突破 94 美元，股市下滑
title.en: U.S. intercepts three Iranian tankers; oil surges above $94, stocks slip

summary.en: U.S. stocks slip as Iran tensions escalate with US interception of three oil tankers, pushing Brent above $94/barrel. Tesla's muted AI progress underperforms, while elevated oil prices weigh on growth stocks and inflate inflation expectations. Geopolitical risk premium dominates the session, forcing a risk-off tilt despite prior gains.
summary.zh: 美国拦截三艘油轮后，与伊朗的紧张局势升级，美股下跌，布伦特原油突破每桶 94 美元。特斯拉 AI 业务进展乏善可陈，高油价拖累成长股，并推升通胀预期。尽管此前市场上涨，地缘政治风险溢价仍在这场交易中占主导，市场避险情绪升温。

title.zh: 市场下调霍尔木兹海峡短期风险定价，油价回落延续
title.en: Oil Pullback Extends as Markets Price Lower Immediate Hormuz Risk

summary.en: Markets open with a constructive but cautious tone after Tuesday's relief rally. Oil has cooled from the Hormuz scare, helping Treasury yields stabilize and supporting growth assets, but the tape is still highly headline-sensitive. The setup favors quality tech, semis, and selective duration if energy stays contained, while traders remain alert to renewed geopolitical or inflation shocks.
summary.zh: 美股周三开盘前整体情绪偏建设性，但仍然谨慎。此前因霍尔木兹风险引发的油价冲击有所缓和，带动美债收益率趋稳，并继续支持成长资产表现。不过，市场依然高度受新闻标题驱动。如果能源价格继续受控，优质科技、半导体和部分久期资产仍占优，但交易者仍需警惕地缘政治或通胀风险再次升温。

title.zh: 中国谴责美国封锁霍尔木兹海峡，油价回落至100美元下方
title.en: China Condemns U.S. Hormuz Blockade, Oil Retreats Below $100

summary.en: Markets trade higher as Middle East geopolitics pivots toward de-escalation hopes, with U.S.-Iran talks continuing and oil retreating below $100. Treasury yields edge lower on calmer oil, while cyber-security concerns from Jamie Dimon's Mythos warning add nuanced risk to tech. The rally reflects relief that Hormuz disruption may ease, though fuel supply risks in Europe remain unresolved.
summary.zh: 市场整体走强，中东局势从升级交易转向缓和预期，美伊接触继续，油价回落至100美元下方。随着油价降温，10年期美债收益率小幅回落，但 Jamie Dimon 对 Anthropic Mythos 暴露网络安全脆弱性的警告，又给科技板块增加了一层风险。当前反弹本质上是对霍尔木兹风险暂时缓和的 relief rally，不过欧洲燃料供应隐忧仍未消失。

title.zh: 美伊和平会谈崩溃后美国封锁伊朗港口，油价跳涨 6%
title.en: U.S.-Iran Peace Talks Collapse After U.S. Naval Blockade of Iranian Ports, Oil Prices Surge 6%

summary.en: Markets mixed on Monday as US-Iran peace talks collapsed and Strait of Hormuz blockade sparked oil volatility: Dow -0.6%, S&P -0.3%, Nasdaq -0.4%. Oil briefly surged above $100 before easing. Tech underperformed as geopolitical risk premium elevated, while energy producers benefited. 10Y Treasury yields stable at 4.29% despite oil spike. Investors weighing recession risks from energy inflation versus earnings quality support.
summary.zh: 美股周一受挫：美伊和平会谈破裂，霍尔木兹海峡封锁引发油价波动：道指 -0.6%、标普 -0.3%、纳指 -0.4%。WTI 跳涨突破 100 美元后回落。科技股受地缘政治压制，能源板块受益。10Y 美债收益率稳定在 4.29%。投资者权衡能源通胀引发的衰退风险与财报质量的支撑。

title.zh: 通胀数据偏热，市场重新强化“更高更久”的利率定价
title.en: Hot inflation print keeps 'higher for longer' back in the market

summary.en: Markets stayed mixed under the same macro headline: energy-driven inflation pressure. Oil remained elevated enough to keep 'higher for longer' rate fears alive, which capped broad risk appetite, but Nasdaq still showed relative resilience as investors kept rotating toward higher-quality growth instead of fully abandoning tech.
summary.zh: 今天市场依然被同一条宏观主线牵着走：能源推动的通胀压力。油价仍处高位，足以让市场继续交易“利率更高、更久”，压制广义风险偏好；但纳指仍表现出相对韧性，说明资金不是完全撤出科技，而是在往更高质量的成长资产收缩。

title.zh: 油价走高、停火叙事变脆弱，美股整体转为小幅回落
title.en: U.S. stocks slip as traders digest higher oil and a more fragile ceasefire backdrop

summary.en: U.S. equities opened with a cautious, slightly risk-off tone as oil surged and Treasury yields stayed elevated, offsetting some of the relief from the recent U.S.-Iran ceasefire narrative. The S&P 500, Nasdaq, and Dow were all modestly lower, which suggests the market is no longer blindly chasing yesterday's rebound and is instead re-pricing inflation, energy, and headline fragility together.
summary.zh: 美股今天开盘时基调偏谨慎、略偏 偏向避险：油价大涨、长端美债收益率维持高位，抵消了此前美伊停火叙事带来的部分缓和情绪。标普、纳指和道指都小幅回落，说明市场已经不再继续追涨，而是在同时重新定价通胀、能源和 消息面风险。

title.zh: 停火预期推动美股大涨，市场出现全面缓和式反弹
title.en: U.S. stocks rip higher as ceasefire hopes trigger a broad relief rally

summary.en: U.S. equities staged a sharp relief rally as markets leaned into a fragile U.S.-Iran ceasefire narrative, pushing the S&P 500 up about 2.5%, the Nasdaq up about 2.8%, and the Dow up about 2.9%. The tone flipped risk-on, led by technology and duration-sensitive assets, but the whole move still rests on whether Middle East de-escalation holds and whether oil avoids a renewed spike.
summary.zh: 美股今天走出明显的缓和式反弹：市场重新押注美伊停火叙事，标普约涨 2.5%、纳指约涨 2.8%、道指约涨 2.9%。整体情绪转向 风险偏好回升，科技和长久期资产领涨，但这波行情的根基仍取决于中东局势是否真的持续降温，以及油价会不会再次急冲。

title.zh: 中东出现停火窗口，全球市场暂时松一口气
title.en: Middle East ceasefire window gives global markets room to breathe

summary.en: Markets turned cautiously risk-on as a two-week Middle East ceasefire window eased immediate Strait of Hormuz fears. U.S. equities were mixed-to-slightly higher, 10Y Treasury yields fell to about 4.24%, and oil backed off from panic highs, but the macro tape remained hostage to geopolitical headlines and energy pass-through risk.
summary.zh: 市场重新偏向谨慎 风险偏好回升：中东出现两周停火窗口，市场对霍尔木兹海峡风险的短期恐慌缓解。美股主要指数小幅分化偏强，10 年期美债收益率回落至约 4.24%，油价也从恐慌高位回落，但宏观主线仍然被地缘政治和能源传导风险主导。
